provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from YAML 1.2.2 sections 5.7 and 7.3.1 and the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, section 4.1; each escape's decoded text is written out by hand.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Every YAML 1.2.2 double-quoted escape, alone and inside text; escaped line breaks; escape-only scalars whose encoded and decoded lengths differ, up to 4 KiB; and every proper prefix of each hex escape, a non-hex digit inside one, undefined escape letters, and a backslash at end of input, all syntax errors. Bound to the revision 1.3 profile; expectations are identical to the revision 1.1 recipe because no input in this set is affected by 1.2/E-1 to E-3 or 1.3/E-1 to E-4.
